name: AutoFix
description: Automatically sanitizes messy release titles, resolves missing TMDb metadata, injects posters, and cleans junk/duplicate files.
overview: Permanently eliminates blank grey boxes in Jellyfin by pre-cleaning messy release names, resolving TMDb IDs, injecting artwork, and auto-cleaning junk/duplicate files.
